title: Why don't Americans use electric kettles?
summary: Technology Connections explains why electric kettles are uncommon in the US, centering on 120V circuits limiting power. He tests ways of boiling water on gas, electric ranges and kettles.
why: HN cites it constantly in threads on voltage, gas stoves and boiling water as the definitive measured comparison, with the kettle coming out fastest and most efficient.

quote.text: Technology Connections on YouTube has a good video about how electric kettles are the superior way to boil water
